notes.title: Update 0.5.3
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
This small update is prepping for more things to come. I have greatly appreciated the feedback the community has given so far. So if you have anything to report about the experience of UldreVoid don’t hesitate to let me know!

 0.5.3 patch notes

[list]
[*] Mouse sensitivity options added for X and Y
[*] Invert mouse options added
[*] Movement controls now correctly save and can be modified 
[*] Audio levels save correctly when adjusted
[*] Aliasing options added to Graphics menu
[*] Motion blur settings added to Graphics menu
[*] Armor models of player now saved correctly when loading a save game
[*] Minor spelling and grammar fixes
[*] Kaldavsil valley optimized grass for better performance
[*] Some large assets downsized resulting in overall smaller game size
[*] Game content placed into more chunks for faster updating in the future as well as loading fixes
[/list]
